Actor Dhanush Urges Students to Prioritize Mother Tongue Tamil

Actor Dhanush addressed students at his alma mater, urging them to prioritize learning their mother tongue, Tamil. He stated that not knowing one's mother tongue is "shameful" and an "insult." Dhanush emphasized that knowing the mother tongue should come first for any individual.
